hypotheses: During an intent loop the AI proposes at most one study idea per step, and only when no question waits for the owner (a study proposed ahead of waiting questions sits outside this count, as SR-336 says), and none when nothing valuable stands out, chosen from: the key architectural choices being made or built, areas the owner likely understands little, what they need to know to choose well later, open conflicts waiting for their choice, and features worth considering. An idea is a title and one line of why, with the depth the AI recommends; the AI writes nothing before the owner accepts it. Once the owner accepts and picks a depth (the Markdown page only, with diagrams, or a video), the AI writes the study at that depth: a page in the browser room in plain words with the examples from the records, diagrams drawn when that depth is chosen.

given the plan step introduces a new background job, when the AI picks a study, then it proposes the idea 'How iaso's background jobs run', recommending the depth with diagrams, and writes nothing until the owner accepts it
given an intent conflict waits for the owner's choice, when the AI picks a study, then it may propose a study laying out both sides so the owner can choose knowingly
given the picture says the owner already knows the topic of the step, when the AI picks a study, then it proposes none for that step
given the build step adds code that would make a new feature easy, when the AI picks a study, then it may propose that feature as a study, labelled a suggestion
given a loop with three steps, when it ends, then at most three studies were proposed
given the AI sees a study worth proposing in the plan step, when it proposes it, then only the idea exists (title, why, recommended depth) and no study page is written
given the owner accepted an idea and chose 'diagrams', when the AI writes the study, then the room shows it in plain words with its diagrams drawn
given the owner accepted an idea and chose 'Markdown only', when the AI writes the study, then the page has no diagram, even where the AI recommended one
given the owner declines an idea, when the AI next picks studies, then nothing is written and the idea is not proposed again
